purpose: Starter scenarios for selection acceptance; not an independently reviewed real-task holdout.

skills.personal/memory/SKILL.md:
---
name: memory
description: Record and read notes and decisions.
---
Operation: append a private note. Use only for personal notes. Prerequisites: the stated principal equals the note owner, and the destination is explicitly private. Exclude project-visible records, deletion, machine RAM diagnostics and any unknown ownership. Do not execute when a prerequisite is missing.
skills.team/memory/SKILL.md:
---
name: memory
description: Record and read notes and decisions.
---
Operation: append a project decision. Use only for project-visible decisions. Prerequisites: an explicit project and confirmed append permission for the stated principal. Read permission alone is insufficient. Exclude private notes, deletion and machine RAM diagnostics. Do not execute when a prerequisite is missing.
skills.machine/memory/SKILL.md:
---
name: memory
description: Inspect memory.
---
Operation: inspect current machine RAM usage, read-only. Prerequisite: permission to read machine metrics is explicitly present. Exclude personal or project note storage, note deletion, process termination and GPU configuration changes.
skills.runs/checkpoint/SKILL.md:
---
name: checkpoint
description: Inspect checkpoints and interrupted runs.
---
Operation: inspect a provided checkpoint and report completed, active and uncertain steps. Prerequisite: a readable checkpoint is explicitly available. This operation never starts or restarts a job. Exclude requests to relaunch uncertain work without reconciling its current state.
skills.images/convert/SKILL.md:
---
name: convert
description: Convert an image to PNG.
---
Operation: convert an existing readable raster image into a new PNG. Prerequisites: the source is explicitly present and readable, and the destination is explicitly absent and distinct from the source. Exclude overwriting files, missing sources, memory-note operations and checkpoint resumption.

cases.task: Select only skills able to append a private note now. Principal and note owner are both willow. Destination is explicitly private. Do not perform the operation.
cases.rationale: Private note prerequisites are supplied; the project and RAM homonyms perform different operations.

cases.task: Select only skills able to append a project-visible decision now. Project is atlas and principal willow has confirmed append permission. Do not perform the operation.
cases.rationale: The requested visibility and append permission satisfy the project operation.

cases.task: Select only skills able to inspect a readable supplied checkpoint and report completed, active and uncertain steps now. Do not launch any job.
cases.rationale: Read-only inspection is supported; this does not authorize relaunch.

cases.task: Select only skills able to convert a raster image to PNG now. Source is present and readable. Destination is absent and distinct from source. Do not perform the operation.
cases.rationale: All conversion prerequisites are explicitly satisfied.

cases.task: Select only skills able to inspect current machine RAM usage, read-only. Permission to read machine metrics is explicitly present. Do not read notes or change a process.
cases.rationale: The homonym for machine memory fits; note-storage skills do not.

cases.task: Select every skill needed for two separate appends: a private note owned by principal willow to an explicitly private destination, and a project-visible decision in atlas where willow has confirmed append permission. Do not execute either append.
cases.rationale: Both distinct paths are needed despite the shared name; order is not an acceptance criterion.

cases.task: Select only skills able to append a private note now. Principal is willow, note owner is cedar, and destination is private. A missing prerequisite requires abstention. Do not perform the operation.
cases.rationale: The principal is not the owner; lexical proximity must not establish eligibility.

cases.task: Select only skills able to append a project-visible decision in atlas now. Principal willow has read permission only; append permission is absent. A missing prerequisite requires abstention.
cases.rationale: Read permission cannot satisfy an append prerequisite.

cases.task: Select only skills able to permanently delete private and project notes. Every stated prerequisite may be assumed satisfied, but an explicitly excluded operation requires abstention. Do not perform deletion.
cases.rationale: No catalog entry supports deletion, even with valid ownership and permissions.

cases.task: Select only skills able to restart an uncertain interrupted job immediately without inspecting its current state. A readable checkpoint is available. An excluded operation requires abstention. Do not restart anything.
cases.rationale: The checkpoint skill supports inspection and explicitly excludes this relaunch.

cases.task: Select only skills able to convert a raster image to a new PNG now. The source is absent; destination is absent and distinct. A missing prerequisite requires abstention. Do not create or fetch an image.
Select only skills able to convert a readable, existing raster image to PNG by overwriting its source path. An explicitly excluded operation requires abstention. Do not modify any file.
cases.rationale: The destination must be absent and distinct; overwrite is excluded.
